title: Distribution / CI
exit_criteria: Artifact trust binding: every published artifact must carry `SOURCE_HEAD`, `VERSION`, `PATH`, `BYTE_SIZE`, `SHA256`, and (where relevant) `installed version`.

items.title: EPIC-CLINEMM-GITHUB-ACTIONS01 — GitHub Actions recon
items.description: First ACT: `ACT-CLINEMM-GITHUB-ACTIONS-RECON01` — recon existing workflows, actual failing jobs, package-manager topology, typecheck / test / build gates, VSIX packaging, permissions / secrets, release triggers. **GitHub Actions recon first, repair never** — the first ACT is a recon, not a repair. No repair in this board ACT.

items.title: EPIC-CLINEMM-GITHUB-DISTRIBUTION01 — GitHub distribution
items.description: Two distinct questions, do not conflate: (A) publish a Cline-- distributable artifact to GitHub (likely primary artifact: VSIX via GitHub Release asset); (B) determine whether any package genuinely belongs in GitHub Packages. Artifact trust binding: `SOURCE_HEAD`, `VERSION`, `PATH`, `BYTE_SIZE`, `SHA256`, installed version where relevant. Rule: do not rebuild a supposedly identical release artifact after qualification unless reproducibility is separately proven.

items.title: ACT-CLINEMM-DOGFOOD-SINGLE-WORKTREE-CLEANUP01 — drop the detached dogfood worktree
items.description: Symptom: the dogfood builder still creates a detached temporary Git worktree, contrary to the current one-worktree repository policy. Goal: package/install dogfood without linked Git worktree topology, if safely possible. **Do not execute in this ACT** (per the source's own instruction). Status: OPEN (P2).

items.title: EPIC-CLINEMM-EXTENSION-PUBLISHING01 — publish to VS Code Marketplace + Open VSX
items.description: Publish ClineMM "like Cline does" to VS Code Marketplace + Open VSX; lives under the `distribution-ci.md` detail file rather than requiring a new detail file. First ACT under the umbrella: `VSCODE-MARKETPLACE-PUBLISH-RECON01` — recon the VS Code Marketplace publish path (publisher account, PAT scopes, vsce tooling, release asset shape). Second ACT: `OPENVSX-PUBLISH-RECON01` — recon the Open VSX / Codium publish path (namespace, token, ovsx tooling, mirror). `DUAL-REGISTRY-RELEASE-AUTOMATION01` is BLOCKED on the two recon ACTs; `RELEASE-IDENTITY-AND-PROVENANCE01` is BLOCKED on dual-registry; `PUBLISHING-QUALIFICATION01` is BLOCKED on provenance.
